description: Uninstall a One-Click App from a dedicated server. Keeps the app data unless deleteVolumes=true. Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

deleteVolumes.description: Also delete the app's persistent data (volumes). Only when the user explicitly asked for it; default keeps the data.

serviceId.description: ID of the Dedicated server: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_dedicated_servers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: uninstall_dedicated_app
title: Uninstall Dedicated Server One-Click App
